about.label: About
about.heading: Curious by nature Developer by choice
about.p1: Hi! I'm Benjamin, a junior developer with a background in <1>DAW</1> and <2>DAM</2>. I enjoy building web, backend and mobile applications and learning by turning ideas into real projects.
about.p2: I'm currently exploring <1>Blockchain and Web3 development</1>, combining the foundations I've built as a developer with a new area I'm genuinely curious about. <2>Still learning. Already building.</2>
